answer: The strongest single control I know for this is Accredited mime artist record with mime association certification, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. A farm running 479 aliases would need 479 separate proofs, each costing about 110 POA or 13 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. One vault of signal, one nectar of cost, one nadir of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
